title.narrative: Mission-wide Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Platform

description.narrative: (Ghana): USAID will use FY 2022 funds to effectively measure, analyze, and evaluate data related to results, track progress, adjust, and assess impact under its Ghana Country Development Cooperation Strategy. USAID will implement technical assistance and analytical services procured to enhance its performance monitoring and evaluation practices and strengthen evidence-based programming and learning across the Mission's portfolios. Services provided under this mechanism will improve the Mission's ability to measure, analyze and communicate the impact of USAID programming in Ghana. The MEL Platform will support technical teams, implementing partners, and the Government of Ghana counterparts to effectively monitor performance; conduct analysis, assessments, and evaluations; conduct key research; and develop an adaptive learning agenda. Additionally, the Platform will support USAID/Ghana to institutionalize a Collaboration, Learning and Adaptation (CLA) approach to ensure that USG-funded interventions collect, analyze, share out and use appropriate data to make evidence-based decisions to improve outcomes. FY 2022 funds will be used to conduct research, baselines assessments and evaluations to inform future programmatic decisions and identify potential areas of collaboration between governance, democracy, accountability, health including water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH), nutrition, agriculture and education programs on cross-cutting issues such as the relationship between nutritional deficits, delayed cognitive development and academic success, and assessments to monitor equitable access to water, sanitation and hygiene through targeting the poorest and most vulnerable in Ghana.
